Activity Tasks (Daily Limit: 20 Great Keys)

1. During the evnt, take part in the daily Activity Tasks to get a maximum of free Great Keys*20. The Great Key can also be bought in the Time-Limited Shop.

2. Great Key can be used to open the Great Plate! Each time you open the plat, various items can be obtained, furthermore, you can also claim a fixed rewards when you use the required amount of keys!

3. Once the event ends, all Great Keys data will be erased from players' inventory. Rewards not claimed for reaching the required amount of keys will also be automatically sent to your mailbox.
